data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis bonus): Add p95 perf test gating dd-5 (≤500ms overhead). Add test in test_telemetry_integration.py: (a) start local HTTP mock sleeping 50ms; (b) run dispatch_review 10x with telemetry.endpoint set vs unset; (c) assert max(p95_with - p95_baseline) ≤ 500ms. @pytest.mark.perf so excludable from fast suites but gated by CI.
